ai_assessment.method: Full original-to-Vietnamese passage comparison followed by literary and editorial critique.
ai_assessment.limitations: Single-model AI assessment, not independent human verification, model diversity or consensus. The assessor also edited the text and had access to prior AI scores and notes; this is not a blind review. All canonical source/target passages were compared, but no new historical-witness collation, native-reader trial or recorded oral performance was conducted for this v2 assessment. Scores are subjective judgments, and undetected errors may remain. This record supplies no legal clearance or human endorsement.

findings.explanation: The elevated allegorical title Lạc Thú Chỉ Lưu Lại Một Khoảnh Khắc retains the fleeting-duration contrast, but its length slows the cadence. Retain the current reading rather than introduce the unsupported residual-time implication of Chỉ Còn.

Điều đã chết preserves the deliberately unnamed referent, but it strains ordinary Vietnamese collocation. Thứ đã chết remains a possible alternative; identifying a woman, spouse or person would add information absent from the source.

summary: Fresh v2 AI assessment of all five unchanged source/target passages. The weighted result is 8.60/10: semantic fidelity 9.0 for complete propositions and preserved ambiguity; voice 8.0 for the still-heavy allegorical cadence; naturalness 8.5 for generally readable prose with điều đã chết remaining strained; imagery 8.5 for consistent bronze, image, sorrow/pleasure and personified fire with deliberately broad đồng; mechanics 9.0 for consistent quotation, capitalization and parallel structure. The repeated world/bronze/image chain, the undying love/enduring sorrow parallel, the furnace transfer and the final remaking are retained. No unresolved major or critical finding was identified in this read. This meets the user-authorized v2 AI score threshold; it is neither human endorsement nor rights clearance. No text was changed merely to obtain a qualifying mark.
